candidate_relations.reason: Although anti-SSA/Ro positivity and annular plaques can occur in subacute cutaneous lupus, the benchmark diagnosis is defined by nonbullous lesions with a neutrophilic, histiocytoid myeloperoxidase-positive infiltrate and no vasculitis or blister formation.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different cutaneous lupus subtype; subacute cutaneous lupus does not specify the nonbullous neutrophilic variant.
